severity_criteria.source_excerpt: 5.1 Inclusion Criteria, criterion 3: "Subjects must have moderate to severe plaque psoriasis of the scalp at Screening and at" "Baseline, defined by:" "•Scalp Investigator Global Assessment (IGA mod 2011 (scalp) of ≥3" "•Psoriasis Scalp Severity Index (PSSI) score of ≥12" "•≥30% or scalp surface area affected." -- The protocol applies criterion 3 at screening and baseline. The extracted text for the third bullet reads ‘≥30% or scalp surface area affected’; represented as percentage of scalp surface area affected while retaining the source’s OCR wording in the evidence quote.

value.population_note: The protocol does not specify a standardized background topical regimen in the cited concomitant-therapy section. It requires recording concomitant medication and allows other concomitant medication case by case with Investigator and Medical Monitor consultation; these statements do not establish a treatment-period permitted or prohibited drug list.

background_therapy.source_excerpt: 6.5 Concomitant Therapy and study treatment descriptions: "o Tildrakizumab 100 mg SC injections" "Any medication or vaccine (including over-the-counter or prescription medicines, vitamins, and/or" "herbal supplements) that the subject is receiving at the time of enrollment or receives during the" "Other concomitant medication may be considered on a case-by-case basis by the Investigator in" "consultation with the Medical Monitor if required." -- No background topical agent, emollient requirement, or concomitant prohibition is inferred from silence. The study drug dose is separately explicit as 100 mg in the treatment description.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: 4.1 Overall Design, study parts and timing: "PART 1: Double-blind Placebo-controlled (Day 1 to Week 16)" "After a Screening Period of up to 28 days and on Day 1, all eligible subjects will be randomized" "PART 2: Double-blind Active Treatment Extension (Week 16 to Week 52)" "PART 3: Observational Safety Follow-up (Week 52 to Week 72)" "After Week 52 (or early termination of study treatment prior to Week 52), the study treatment" "The primary efficacy endpoint for this study is the proportion of subjects with IGA mod 2011(scalp) score" "with at least 2-point reduction from baseline at Week 16." -- The protocol states a screening period of up to 28 days; screening_days records the stated maximum. Study parts are Day 1 to Week 16 double-blind placebo-controlled treatment, Week 16 to Week 52 double-blind active treatment extension, then Week 52 to Week 72 observational safety follow-up. The protocol gives Day 1 as the beginning of the first treatment period; it does not state a week-number start, so start_week is null. The protocol identifies the primary efficacy endpoint at Week 16. The selected protocol text references a Schedule of Activities but contains no full per-visit schedule table; visit cadence and individual visit/contact details are therefore null. Unstated durations and intervals are not calculated from period boundaries.

published_results.source_excerpt: 14 Clinical Studies, Table 3, Trial 4 (NCT03897088), Week 16 rows: "Psoriasis of the Scalp In a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (Trial 4 [NCT03897088]) 231 subjects with moderate-to-severe psoriasis of the scalp (IGA Scalp score of 3 or 4) were treated subcutaneously with ILUMYA 100 mg (n=117) or placebo (n=114) at Weeks 0 and 4." "Table 3: Efficacy Results for Primary and Secondary Endpoints in Adults with Moderate-to-Severe Psoriasis of the Scalp in Trial 4 (mITT, NRI*) Note: IGA = Investigator Global Assessment." "Trial 4 (NCT03897088) ILUMYA 100 mg (N=89) n (%) Placebo (N=82) n (%) Primary Endpoint IGA Scalp Response Rate for score 0 or 1 (clear or almost clear) at Week 16 with at least 2-point reduction from baseline score 44 (49) 6 (7) Secondary Endpoints PSSI 90 Response Rate at Week 16 54 (61) 4 (5) IGA Scalp Response Rate for score 0 or 1 (clear or almost clear) at Week 12 with at least 2-point reduction from baseline score 41 (46) 4 (5) PSSI 90 Response Rate at Week 12 43 (48) 2 (2) Psoriasis of the Nail In a randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (Trial 5 [NCT03897075]), 99 subjects with moderate to severe psoriasis of the nail received subcutaneous ILUMYA 100 mg (N=51) or placebo (N=48) at Weeks 0, 4, and 16." -- Trial 4 is explicitly mapped to NCT03897088. Table 3 labels its analysis mITT/NRI, which cannot be represented by the schema's analysis_population enum, so that subfield is null. Counts, reported percentages, table denominators, and Week 16 are copied directly. Results are limited to Week 16 endpoints with exact listed endpoint-key/timepoint matches; no Week 12 join was made.
